site.title: OfferMarket - Reverse Talent Marketplace
site.description: Anonymous worker profiles meet structured employer offers

hero.title: A Reverse Talent Marketplace
hero.subtitle: Create an anonymous profile. Receive structured offers with transparent salary and benefits. Accept when ready – your identity stays hidden until then.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.step1Body: Your identity is hidden. Employers see your skills and experience, but not your name or current employer.
howItWorks.step2Body: Every offer includes specific salary, complete benefits, and clear contract terms. No vague messages allowed.
howItWorks.step3Body: When you accept an offer, your identity is revealed. Only then can the employer contact you directly.

forWorkers.title: For Workers
forWorkers.benefit1: Complete anonymity until you choose to reveal
forWorkers.benefit2: All offers have transparent salary and benefits
forWorkers.benefit3: No spam, no empty recruiter messages
forWorkers.benefit5: Block companies you don't want to see your profile

forEmployers.title: For Employers
forEmployers.benefit1: Access to passive candidates who aren't actively applying
forEmployers.benefit2: Stand out with transparent, competitive offers

cta.title: Ready to Get Started?
cta.subtitle: Join the reverse marketplace where workers have leverage and employers compete with real offers.
